Method of Attack: Malicious emails with zipped JavaScript (.js) attachments that download and execute malware payloads
Downloader Trojan that fetches additional payloads from command-and-control servers
Ransomware encrypting files on compromised systems
Worm with spam and backdoor capabilities
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (implied by Win32 and file paths)
Systems with locale set to China, Vietnam, South Korea, Japan, Turkey, Germany, Australia, UK

Execution of downloaded EXE files saved in local AppData folders

Attachment file names in format PIC0-[9-digit-number]2019-jpg.zip
Downloaded EXE files named Temp[random].exe in C:\Users\[username]\AppData\Local\
Command-and-control server with Ukrainian IP address
